column3: After #102, the policy's request.respond hook and its grants act only on request ids starting "approval:", never on kind "approval" alone; questions.ask opens an approval on a coordinator or the root chat but keeps other cards inside threads, and request.respond holds every card to owner-only and its own options on both paths
column4: #102 gave request_approval (q:<task>, Approve or Deny, no held-back call) the same kind as policy holds, so a kind check would let an agent's ask take Always allow or a grant; connect and secret cards still have no answer path outside a thread
column5: plugins/policy/policy.test.ts: an agent ask refuses Always allow, Approve starts the run with plain "Approve" and leaves no grant and no policy change (fails with the prefix check removed); the key, number, escaped and row/socket redaction tests each fail when their piece of redaction is reverted
